quantities.conc: concentration of the central compartment at the time t of the origin shared by the dose times: the sum of the single-dose functions of every dose (0 before the first dose; a bolus exactly at its dose time counts)
quantities.auc: sum of the single-dose areas, each from its own dose time (not from its lag), to the time
quantities.scalar: auc_inf = sum of the doses / CL

method.closed_form: plain sum of the single-dose closed forms of the model (MOD-3C-10..14, the lag as a delay), 256-bit arithmetic (Rmpfr), rounded once to double; areas are the exact integrals of the terms; steady state is the sum over j = 0..N with the tail below 2^-70 of the smallest value; the area over one interval is checked against D/CL
cross_checks: adaptive ODE solver (deSolve lsoda, rtol 1e-12) with the doses as events and a state for the AUC
steady state: a long train of dosing events read after the last dose
